class Box<T> {
  constructor(public value: T) {}
}

class NumberBox extends Box<number> {}

class ListBox<U> extends Box<U[]> {}

class ForwardBox<U> extends Box<U> {
  constructor(value: U) {
    super(value);
  }
}

class Tagged<U> extends NumberBox {
  tag?: U;
}

class Counter {
  constructor(public count: number) {}
}

class Child extends Counter {}

class GrandChild extends Child {
  constructor() {
    super(2);
  }
}

function withLabel<T>() {
  return class {
    label?: T;
  };
}

class Labeled extends withLabel<number>() {}

const Anonymous = class extends Box<string> {};

const numbers = new NumberBox(1);
console.log(numbers.value + 1);
const list = new ListBox([1, 2]);
console.log(list.value.length);
const forwarded: ForwardBox<number> = new ForwardBox(3);
console.log(forwarded.value, forwarded instanceof Box);
const tagged = new Tagged<string>(4);
console.log(tagged.value, tagged.tag);
console.log(new GrandChild().count, new Child(5).count);
console.log(new Labeled().label);
console.log(new Anonymous("a").value);
